title: What is the base of the exponent?
text: Without parentheses, the exponent binds only to the 3. The expression means 'the opposite of $$3^{2}$$,' not '$$(-3)$$ squared.' A common mistake is to treat this as identical to $$(-3)^{2}$$. What is $$3^{2}$$?

title: Apply the leading minus
text: The minus is applied after the exponent. What is the opposite of 9?

title: Worked solution
text: $$-3^{2} = -(3^{2}) = -9$$. Common mistake: squaring $$-3$$ and answering $$9$$. General rule: $$-a^{n}$$ means $$-(a^{n})$$. Use parentheses, $$(-a)^{n}$$, when the sign is part of the base.
